why:
Measured against the recorded upstream surfaces (`docs/reference/api-surface/{rclc,rclcpp,rclrs}.json`): none of them contains `park`, `wake_source`, `spin_nominal` or `granularity` at all, so there is no upstream name to align to. Same basis as the `Executor::release_jitter` pair beside it.

phase-436, re-exported from the `nros` umbrella by B2 because a board that registers a deadline source has to know the capacity it can be refused at. How many platform sources one executor carries: a plain const, not a sizing knob, because the table is INLINE — no allocator, which is the whole reason this seam exists on the targets it exists for. rclrs has no wake-source concept, so there is nothing to size against.
